blocks.prompt: 6 (a) A drug company has manufactured 7 million doses of a vaccine to date. They promise additional production at a rate of 1.4 million doses/month over the next year. How many doses of the vaccine, in total, will have been produced after a year?
blocks.explanation:
The total grows by the same 1.4 million each month: an A.P.
Plan: a year is 12 months; add 12 months of new doses to the 7 million already made.
steps:
Given: 7 million doses so far; 1.4 million more each month for the next 12 months.
To find: the total after one year.
Method: Total after \(n\) months \(= 7 + 1.4n\) (millions); a year means \(n = 12\).

Add a year's production to the doses already made
\[\text{Total} = 7 + 1.4 \times 12\]
\[= 7 + 16.8\]
\[= 23.8\]
Why: 12 months at 1.4 million each is 16.8 million new doses; "in total" means we add the 7 million made before.

blocks.prompt: 6 (b) A drug company has manufactured 7 million doses of a vaccine to date. They promise additional production at a rate of 1.4 million doses/month over the next year. The general term \(a_n\) describes the total number of doses of the vaccine produced. Describe the meaning of the variable \(n\) in the context of this problem. Find the general term \(a_n\)
blocks.explanation:
We must say what \(n\) counts, then write the total as an A.P. formula.
The total changes once a month, so \(n\) counts months.
steps:
Given: 7 million doses so far; 1.4 million more each month for the next 12 months.
To find: the meaning of \(n\) and the formula for \(a_n\).
Method: A.P. with starting value 7 and common difference 1.4.

Decide what \(n\) means
\[n = \text{months from now}\]
Why: The production is given per month, so \(n\) is the number of months from today (\(n = 0\) today).

Write the general term
\[a_n = 7 + 1.4n\]
\[\text{(millions of doses)}\]
Why: Start with 7 million and add 1.4 million for each of the \(n\) months.
blocks.final_answer: \(n\) = number of months from now; \(a_n = 7 + 1.4n\) million doses

blocks.prompt: 6 (c) A drug company has manufactured 7 million doses of a vaccine to date. They promise additional production at a rate of 1.4 million doses/month over the next year. Find the value of \(a_{10}\) and interpret its meaning in words.
blocks.explanation: Put \(n = 10\) in the general term from (b) and say what the number means.
steps:
Given: 7 million doses so far; 1.4 million more each month for the next 12 months.
To find: \(a_{10}\) and its meaning.
Method: Use \(a_n = 7 + 1.4n\) from part (b) with \(n = 10\).

Interpret
Why: \(a_n\) is a total in millions and \(n\) counts months, so \(a_{10} = 21\) means 21 million doses in total will have been produced 10 months from now.
blocks.final_answer: \(a_{10} = 21\): 21 million doses in total after 10 months
